title: After a lifetime of just playing games, I used AI to finally build one — with zero coding background
author: the_builder_ai
selftext:
I'm a long-time gamer with zero coding experience, and AI has finally gotten to the point where I could actually build something real — the part left to me was the creative direction, which is the part I enjoy anyway.

My first game is GATEFRONT: a 3D arcade squad-runner where you swap lanes, shoot "gates" to grow your squad, then take over vehicles for boss fights. It's free, runs in the browser, no download, no monetization, and I tried not to make it grindy — I mostly just wanted it to be fun.

I'm sharing it because I think it's a decent example of what's now possible solo with AI if you don't come from a dev background. Happy to go into the pipeline in the comments — what worked, what absolutely didn't, and where AI saved time vs. where I still had to figure things out myself. Planning to put together a video on the build to share tips and the pitfalls too.

Link: [https://gatefrontgames.itch.io/gatefront](https://gatefrontgames.itch.io/gatefront)

comments.author: kilographix
comments.body: You made the game from the ads but for real!

replies.author: Soul_Mate_4ever
replies.body: lol. I’ve seen this ad before

replies.author: kilographix
replies.body: Yeah I'm not really hating, the games that are supposed to play like those never do from the ones I've tried.

replies.author: Lower-Hedgehog-9835
replies.body: "Make that god damn ad game that I wanna play but is just spam" seems like a good prompt

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: That was exactly the idea — a lot of those ads turn out to be nothing like it. Figured I'd actually try to build the thing they promise as a first project.

comments.author: Zerrul
comments.body: You could build anything, and you chose to build a slop mobile ads game? 🤣 Cool though

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: Honestly this one was more of a "can I even do this end to end?" trial — take it from idea to shipped, learn the whole pipeline. As this is the very first game I've built it is a good learning process. Now that I know what's possible, will be building more with original ideas. Appreciate you checking it out!

comments.author: NewKingCole11
comments.body: “the part left to me was the creative direction, which is the part I enjoy anyway.” but you just copied a mobile game ad?

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: Fair enough. I agree "creative direction" may be bit too generous but my initial goal was to make a playable game and starting with something that people can pick up easier. I've actually tried to add in a lot of different elements in there like different vehicles and boss fight designs but those probably aren't immediately obvious.

comments.author: DocHolidayPhD
comments.body: You absolutely have to love the high def live action video intro mixed with this absolutely lackluster gameplay.

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: The intro was genuinely one of the most fun part to make and learning how to blend that to the gameplay was a process. Tried to add in some additional elements on top of the original game including boss fights but definitely more to work on. Thanks for trying!

comments.author: chimoprass
comments.body: Too bad it doesn't keep going like the opening vid, there's plenty of these ad copies out there.

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback. I've tried to add more elements in there with more varied bosses, but I get that this format's been pretty well-trodden at this point. This one was more a proof-of-concept for me building with no coding experience and a first build. Thanks for giving it a try.

comments.author: edjelly
comments.body: Although I agree with the comments that you’re definitely overstating your “creative direction”, I still think it’s cool that you built and shipped something with 0 experience.

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: Thanks for the comment and yeah, fair, "creative direction" is probably a bit overstated 😅 I did try to layer some of my own stuff on top of the base format: the bosses have different phases (the final one actually plays a bit like Diablo 4 and behaves differently with different health levels), and I had to hand-place the environment rather than leaving it all to prompts. Kept most of that out of the trailer so I wasn't spoiling it. Appreciate you giving it a fair look and will learn from this first build🙏

comments.author: NoEye89
comments.body:
Good job! Now that you know you can do it, I highly recommend coming up with something unique :)

Not being sarcastic, but genuinely, you have the tools at your disposal, go do something amazing.

replies.author: the_builder_ai
replies.body: Thank you, that actually means a lot 🙏 That's exactly the plan — this one was about proving to myself the pipeline works end to end with no experience and now that it does, the next builds I will be able to play with more original ideas.
